categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Modifies `src/net_processing.cpp`, refactoring `PeerManagerImpl::ProcessMessage` to extract handlers for nine P2P message types into separate functions.
categories.rationale: This move-only refactoring breaks up the monolithic `ProcessMessage()` function to improve navigation and encapsulation in `net_processing.cpp`. As noted by reviewers like stickies-v and maflcko, extracting dedicated per-message helpers improves readability and diffing, but it does not address any functional bugs, DoS hazards, or protocol behavior.
